title: Provisional Government Of Free India Singapore
definition: The Arzi Hukumat-e-Azad Hind was a militant provisional government established in Singapore on October 21, 1943, by Subhas Chandra Bose to lead the Indian independence movement from abroad and command the Indian National Army (INA).
importanceInUpsc: It represents the radical phase of the freedom struggle, testing the candidate's understanding of the intersection between international diplomacy, military strategy, and anti-colonial nationalism.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Provisional Government Of Free India Singapore.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
